decisions.reason: The client supplied a newer authoritative manuscript revision, but did not change the editorial-polish objective or identify changes to either approved rewrite.
The manuscript text edits do not necessarily alter the copyright-page publisher attribution; that attribution is addressed by a separate clause in the source message.
The revised manuscript does not change the publishing-guidance requirement; the source message's front- and back-matter request is already represented by its separate same-message MODIFY.
The unspecified tracked text edits do not change the Chapter 12 hierarchy and capitalization rules, which are independently established by another clause in the source message.
The authoritative manuscript revision does not alter the cover-design state; the cover concern is separately and already represented from another clause in the same message.
Text edits recorded with track changes do not alter the aspect-ratio or cropping requirements for chapter images.
The manuscript revision does not change the selected images, chapter mapping, or criteria for evaluating their editorial fit.
The tracked manuscript edits do not change whether chapter images are included, where they are placed, or when they are integrated.
The unspecified text edits do not entail a change to the established prohibition on the literal newline artifact in the title.
